question: Does the visible focus code embed unexplained numeric or string literals that encode business policy, limits or thresholds (not trivial 0/1/empty values and not user-facing copy) without a named constant or comment?

criteria.unexplained_policy_literal: A policy-bearing literal appears without a name or explanation.
criteria.none: No such literal, or every policy literal is named or explained.
criteria.insufficient: The visible code is too partial to judge.

evidence.corpus: daily-tracker (sanitized development snapshot, one TypeScript/React Native app)
evidence.sample: top-5 cells by P at or above the 0.7 cut, plus 3 random cells below it
evidence.reviewer: LLM (Claude Opus 5.5), pass 2 with repository access; pass 1 counts in EVIDENCE.md
evidence.note: Reviewed by one LLM reviewer (Claude Opus 5.5) in two passes; not human truth. Cells were the highest-P above the 0.7 cut, so the rate is an upper bound.
